variants.headline: Still in view: home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. The home world has sent a punitive expedition.

We judge {target} adversely. Punitive power demands an exacting political standard, and the dispatch is an appropriate occasion to question the quality and fairness of the responsibility being exercised.

variants.headline: Still in view: an expedition with a punitive purpose
variants.sub: The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony.
variants.body:

variants.headline: Still in view: distant authority dispatches an expedition
variants.sub: The home world has sent a punitive expedition.
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony.

We judge {target} adversely. Punitive power demands an exacting political standard, and the dispatch is an appropriate occasion to question the quality and fairness of the responsibility being exercised.
